name: Noella Hughes
source:
Affiliation: USF (Ship's Engineer)
Location: Okinawa, Japan
Relationship: Engineer
Personnel File: Noella Hughes was one of the few gifted Terran individuals able to pass the Children of the Future course of Gregorian Engineering. She is active duty USF personnel on loan from the Gregorian Engineering Corps, but some personal issues have left her unable to serve on a frontline military vessel.
Strengths: Hand to Hand Combat, technical genius, courageous, possessed of advanced Gregorian training.
Weaknesses: Alcoholoism, poor discipline, social skills, uncertain loyalties
Note Inserted in file: All redacted information is Gregorian classified intelligence, available only to code word agents or above.
